hero.lead: I design, deploy and maintain IT environments that simply work. Focused on security, business continuity and a web experience polished end to end.

about.title: Infrastructure as the invisible base that lets everything run.
about.p1: I am a systems technician in Palma de Mallorca, and I make sure your company's technology works without you having to think about it. I look after servers, networks, backups, email, devices and desktop support for the team's day-to-day. The goal is for everything to be in its place and, if something fails, for recovery to be fast.
about.p2: I work on the technical infrastructure of the hospitality sector. I manage environments with several servers running in parallel where going dark is not an option. Every day this teaches me to always work with clear documentation, standardization and continuity plans as the foundation of everything.
about.p3: I apply that same way of working to systems administration and IT support for companies in Mallorca. I like building stable environments that hold no surprises and solving problems before they affect your day-to-day.

services.title: Two disciplines, one standard.
services.lead: I work with companies and professionals that need a reliable technical base and a careful web presence. Both built to last and grow.
services.s1Lead: Stable, secure, documented IT environments so your team works without friction.
services.s2Lead: Custom professional websites. Fast, maintainable, built to represent you well.
services.s2b1: Design and development of professional pages
services.s2b2: Corporate sites, portfolios and landing pages

servicesPage.howLead: Whether it is a server or a website, the principles are the same.

portfolio.title: Recent work.
portfolio.lead: These are some of the projects I have been working on and want to share.
portfolio.p1Desc: GPO-launched PowerShell script that gives each user their printers, trays and default printer by reading Active Directory attributes.
portfolio.p2Desc: Save, organize and share your AI prompts and skills in a personal vault with categories and quick copy.
portfolio.p3Desc: Home lab for a smart home: Home Assistant automation, my own VPN, ad blocking and automatic cloud backups.
portfolio.p4Title: FlexGrip: product landing page and direct sales
portfolio.p4Desc: Spanish-language online store for a fitness kit with resistance bands and a hand gripper, with Stripe checkout and guarantees in plain sight.
